source: DELF Prim A1.1 (France Éducation International). DELF Prim publishes no closed word list; every word is in the derived DELF Prim word list (content/src/fr/WORDLIST.md, npm run content:wordlist -- fr) at level A1.1: lemmas attested in the child-facing text of the A1.1 sample papers (delf-prim-a1-1-livret-candidat, -transcription, -livret-examinateur: greetings, name and age questions, family, pets, house, hobbies, colours, clothes, food, school bag, library rules, birthday invitation, times), completed per theme with everyday child words (source topic) and with concepts of Cambridge Starters (source parity: zoo animals, toys). Grammar: être, avoir and s'appeler in the present, the present of everyday verbs as the papers use them, ne … pas, questions by intonation and with qu'est-ce que, numbers 0-20, colours, articles. Dutch translations written by the content author.
